owner_bio_paragraphs: Jane is a licensed electrical contractor in Virginia with over a decade of experience in residential and commercial electrical work. She founded Acme Electrical Solutions to bring transparent pricing and reliable service to the Springfield area.

Jane personally oversees every project from estimate to final inspection. Her approach is diagnostic-first — she identifies the root cause before recommending any work, so you only pay for what you actually need.
